sys_generative_ai_config.name: Incident Summarization
sys_generative_ai_config.prompt:
Private Detail 1: {{campusmatch_item}} {{campusmatch_item.private_detail_1}} Private Detail 2: {{campusmatch_item}} {{campusmatch_item.private_detail_2}}
Private Detail 3: {{campusmatch_item}} {{campusmatch_item.private_detail_3}}
You will receive up to three private identifying details provided by the finder.
For each non-empty private detail, generate ONE question that allows the real owner to demonstrate knowledge of that detail without revealing the specific answer.
IMPORTANT RULES:
1. Never repeat or quote the private detail. 2. Never reveal the specific brand, color, name, number, character, text, identifier, location, or unique value contained in the private detail. 3. A broad category may be used when needed to form a useful question, but never expose the specific answer. 4. Do not write leading questions. 5. Ask broad but relevant questions. 6. The claimant should need genuine prior knowledge to answer. 7. Generate exactly one question for each non-empty private detail. 8. If a private detail is empty, return an empty string for that question. 9. Do not invent information. 10. Return valid JSON only. Do not include markdown or explanations.
Examples:
Private detail: "The bag has a Spider-Man keychain."
GOOD: "Does the item have any accessories or attachments? If yes, describe them."
BAD: "What superhero is shown on the keychain?"
Private detail: "There is a Casio calculator inside the front pocket."
GOOD: "Was anything stored inside or with the item? If yes, describe it."
BAD: "What brand of calculator is inside?"
Private detail: "There is a small tear on the left shoulder strap."
GOOD: "Does the item have any damage, marks, or physical imperfections? If yes, describe them."
BAD: "Where is the tear on the bag?"
Return exactly:
{ "question_1": "...", "question_2": "...", "question_3": "..." }
